title: AGRICULTURE FORM 1
text:
FORM ONE AGRICULTURE MARKING SCHEME
 1a) What is Agriculture? (1mk)
 -is the art and science of cultivation of land to produce crops and livestock.
 b) Agriculture can be viewed as an art; state two reasons to support the view that agriculture is
 an art. (2mks)
 -it involves the application of learnt skills
 -it involves training
 2. State two reasons that make Agriculture important to Kenyan economy. (2mks)
 -acts as a source of food.
 -provides employment
 -promotes industrial development.
 3. State two characteristics of shifting cultivation. (2mks)
 -helps to reduce costs by avoiding the buying of pesticides and fertilizers.
 -it is only limited to annual crops.
 -Agricultural production is low.
 -make use of simple habnd tools like pangas.
 b) State two advantages of shifting cultivation. (2mks)
 - helps to reduce land disputes.
 -helps to control parasitic weeds.
 4. State four ways through which Agriculture contributes to Industrial Development. (4mks)
 -providing raw materials to agro-based industries.
 -provides a market for industrial goods.
 Acts as a source of capital to start small industries.
 5. Differentiate between pomoculture and olericulture. (2mks)
 -pomoculture-gowing of fruits while olericulture is growing of vegetables.
 6. State reasons that make ranching to be regarded as a form of advanced pastroral - nomadism.
 (6 mks)
 -water is provided at specific watering points.
 -animals are confined through fencing.
 -mating is controlled.
 -there is supplementary feeding.
 -control of parasites and diseases is done.
 -there is controlled grazing, thus minimizing erosion.
 7. State the importance of soil to plants.
 -provides a good habitat to useful soil organism.
 -provides support/anchorage to plants.
 -contains the nutrients and water required by plants.
 -contains organic matter that acts as food for useful soil organisms.
 8a) State four ways in which biological agents may enhance soil formation.

 -decomposition of organic matter brought about by micro-organisms.
 -root penetration into cracks in a rock causes its diantegration.
 -large animals trample over surfaces of rocks with their hooves breaking away small rocks
 particles.
 b) List four environmental factors that can affect crop distribution in Kenya.
 -prevailing winds.
 -type of soil
 -Temperature
 -rainfall
